close_reason: Added #[deprecated] to unknown_capability(); existing tests use #[allow(deprecated)]
description: unknown_capability() has no #[deprecated] attribute pointing to unknown_capability_with_detail(). A future contributor (or the existing response.rs test which calls it directly) will continue using the no-detail path. Without a deprecation warning, the 'use this in preference' doc comment is invisible at call sites. The improvement will not actually propagate unless the old constructor is deprecated or removed.
title: unknown_capability() not deprecated: old no-detail constructor still callable with no warning
